description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Tax' controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles initialization and configuration of tax-related settings during the startup process, including setting addresses and store information in the tax library.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: A controller class responsible for setting up tax-related configurations during the startup phase of the cart process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the tax settings by creating a new Tax object and configuring addresses based on session data or default configuration.
